source_text.body:
Get move suggestions for card games from screenshots
An n8n Telegram workflow uses GPT-4o vision to read screenshots or voice messages and suggest moves for poker, blackjack, dominoes and mahjong; advice only.
Done with
N8
n8n
What they did
This is an n8n workflow that runs inside Telegram and uses GPT-4o. The source says it reads game screenshots or voice messages and suggests moves for poker, blackjack, dominoes and mahjong. The fetched page was only a short product listing, so it gives no detail on the individual steps.
How it went
The page reports no results, numbers or test outcomes. It only describes what the agent is meant to do.
Worth knowing
It is a paid template listed at $100 USD on Gumroad, and the page I could read gives few technical details.
Try it yourself
with
n8n
Copy prompt
Build an n8n workflow with a Telegram bot where I send a screenshot or voice message of a [poker, blackjack, dominoes or mahjong] game. A vision-capable AI model should read the situation and reply with a suggested move and a short reason. It gives advice only and never takes actions. You're done when a test screenshot of [game] returns a sensible suggestion.
Original source: https://treasurium.gumroad.com/l/ultimate_gaming_ai_agent
